wide.label: 全景
wide.zh: 全景交代主体与周围空间的关系。
wide.en: A wide shot establishes the subject's place in the setting.

medium.label: 中景
medium.zh: 中景保留主体上半身和手边的细节。
medium.en: A medium shot holds the subject and nearby details in frame.

medium-closeup.label: 半身特写
medium-closeup.zh: 半身中近景留出肩颈、手势与微表情的空间。
medium-closeup.en: A medium close-up frames the shoulders, hands, and subtle shifts in expression.

close.label: 近景
close.zh: 近景留出观察细微变化的空间。
close.en: A close shot makes the smallest changes easy to see.

closeup.label: 面部特写
closeup.zh: 面部特写集中呈现神情、眼神与光影的微弱变化。
closeup.en: A close-up frames the face closely so small shifts in expression and light remain clear.

low-angle.label: 仰拍
low-angle.zh: 低角度仰拍托出人物姿态与背景天光。
low-angle.en: A low-angle framing looks gently upward, emphasizing posture against the light behind.

high-angle.label: 俯拍
high-angle.zh: 微俯视角收拢人物与桌面或地面的光影层次。
high-angle.en: A gentle high-angle framing reveals the figure together with light and shadows across the surface below.

over-shoulder.label: 过肩视角
over-shoulder.zh: 过肩构图保留近景轮廓，视线顺着前方的画面展开。
over-shoulder.en: An over-the-shoulder framing anchors the foreground figure while opening toward what lies ahead.

back-silhouette.label: 背影侧轮廓
back-silhouette.zh: 侧后方构图交代人物背影线条与前方的开阔空间。
back-silhouette.en: A three-quarter back view traces the subject's silhouette while opening toward the space ahead.

pov.label: 第一人称视角
pov.zh: 平视接近的视角保留身临其境的互动距离。
pov.en: A close eye-level perspective holds an immediate, intimate distance with the subject.

traveler.label: 雨后站台
traveler.zh: 傍晚的空电车站台上，一位旅人撑着透明伞站在雨水浸湿的轨道旁。
traveler.en: At dusk, a traveler stands under a clear umbrella on an empty tram platform beside rain-dark rails.

reader.label: 晨光书房
reader.zh: 清晨，一位读信人坐在书房窗边，手里摊着一封信。
reader.en: In the early morning, a reader holds an open letter beside a study window.

lantern.label: 石巷灯笼
lantern.zh: 暮色沉进石板小巷，檐下只挂着一盏暖色灯笼。
lantern.en: A single amber lantern hangs beneath the eaves of a stone alley at blue hour.

bookshop.label: 旧书店
bookshop.zh: 旧书店的窄书架前，两位读者隔着一本半抽出的精装书站着。
bookshop.en: Two readers stand by a narrow bookcase in a used bookshop, with a half-pulled hardback between them.

adult-couple.label: 窗边成年伴侣
adult-couple.zh: 傍晚，窗边沙发上并肩坐着两位成年伴侣，都穿着质地柔软的针织衫。
adult-couple.en: At dusk, two adult partners in soft knit sweaters sit shoulder to shoulder on a sofa by the window.

private-sitter.label: 晨光里的写真模特
private-sitter.zh: 一位成年写真模特披着松系的丝质睡袍，背对镜头侧坐在透光窗帘前。晨光留在肩颈与袍边。
private-sitter.en: An adult portrait model in a loosely tied silk robe sits sideways with their back to the camera before a translucent curtain. Morning light rests along the shoulder and the edge of the robe.

rooftop-dusk.label: 夕阳天台少女
rooftop-dusk.zh: 黄昏的天台栏杆旁，一位少女迎着晚风站立，长发与裙角自然垂落。
rooftop-dusk.en: At sunset, a young woman stands beside a rooftop railing in the evening breeze, her hair and hem resting lightly.

cafe-window.label: 咖啡馆靠窗
cafe-window.zh: 午后安静的木质咖啡馆里，一位少女坐在靠窗桌边，双手捧着温热的瓷杯。
cafe-window.en: Inside a quiet wooden cafe in the afternoon, a young woman sits by the window holding a warm ceramic cup.

sakura-path.label: 樱花小径漫步
sakura-path.zh: 春日的林荫坡道两旁落满淡粉花瓣，一位穿春装的少女沿路缓步走来。
sakura-path.en: Along a sunlit spring path dusted with pale petals, a young woman in spring attire walks forward at an unhurried pace.

ginkgo-avenue.label: 秋日银杏步道
ginkgo-avenue.zh: 铺满金黄落叶的林荫步道上，一位穿驼色针织外套的少女沿路缓步而立。
ginkgo-avenue.en: Along an autumn walkway carpeted with golden ginkgo leaves, a young woman in a camel knit coat pauses amidst the trees.

train-window.label: 暮色列车窗边
train-window.zh: 傍晚行驶的列车车厢里，一位少女靠在窗边座位上，玻璃外掠过连绵暮色。
train-window.en: Inside an evening train car, a young woman sits beside the window as soft twilight fields glide past outside.

starry-terrace.label: 星夜天台长椅
starry-terrace.zh: 清朗的星夜露台上，一位少女独自坐在木质长椅边缘，抬头望向夜空。
starry-terrace.en: On a clear starlit terrace, a young woman sits on the edge of a wooden bench gazing into the quiet night sky.

tatami-veranda.label: 和室檐廊午后
tatami-veranda.zh: 阳光斜照的木质日式檐廊边，一位少女盘坐着翻开手里的旧书册。
tatami-veranda.en: Along a sunlit wooden veranda of a quiet Japanese room, a young woman sits peacefully with an open book.

library-aisle.label: 静谧图书馆书廊
library-aisle.zh: 安静的古典图书馆高书架旁，一位少女靠着木梯翻看摊在掌心的笔记。
library-aisle.en: Beside tall wooden bookshelves in a quiet library, a young woman leans lightly against a ladder reading notes in her hands.

beach-sunset.label: 黄昏海岸剪影
beach-sunset.zh: 退潮后的湿润沙滩上，一位赤足少女背对落日余晖站在浅浪边缘。
beach-sunset.en: On wet sand at low tide, a barefoot young woman stands at the edge of shallow surf against the setting sun.

neon-crosswalk.label: 霓虹夜街少女
neon-crosswalk.zh: 细雨后的夜晚，一位穿深色外套的少女站在街头玻璃橱窗前，灯牌在身侧亮起。
neon-crosswalk.en: On a damp night after light rain, a young woman in a dark coat stands beside a glowing storefront window.

snow-lamp.label: 雪夜街灯下
snow-lamp.zh: 安静的冬夜街灯下，一位系着厚围巾的少女立在微雪里，呼吸凝出浅淡白雾。
snow-lamp.en: Beneath a quiet winter streetlamp, a young woman in a warm scarf stands in light snow as faint mist forms in the cold air.

stage-idol-dancer.label: 聚光灯舞台独舞者
stage-idol-dancer.zh: 聚光灯轻照的深色镜面舞台中央，一位身着轻盈演出短裙的少女正准备随着律动起舞。
stage-idol-dancer.en: Center stage on a dark reflective dance floor under a crisp spotlight, a young woman in a pleated stage outfit stands poised to begin her dance.

flowing-hanfu-dancer.label: 月夜廊台广袖舞者
flowing-hanfu-dancer.zh: 月光洒落的古典木廊台上，一位穿着飘逸宽袖长裙的舞者舒展身姿，衣袂蓄势欲飞。
flowing-hanfu-dancer.en: On a moonlit traditional wooden pavilion, a graceful dancer in flowing wide-sleeved silk robes holds an opening stance ready to sweep into motion.

ballet-studio-dancer.label: 晨光练功房芭蕾舞者
ballet-studio-dancer.zh: 铺着浅色实木地板的明亮练功房中央，一位穿着轻纱芭蕾舞裙的少女正提起脚尖准备起舞。
ballet-studio-dancer.en: At the center of a bright hardwood dance studio, a young ballerina in an airy tulle skirt rises lightly onto her toes ready to spin.

cyber-popping-dancer.label: 赛博霓虹街舞舞者
cyber-popping-dancer.zh: 细雨湿润的霓虹赛博街头，一位穿着带微光饰边机能外套的舞者压低重心蓄势起舞。
cyber-popping-dancer.en: On a damp neon-lit cyberpunk street, a street dancer in a sleek techwear jacket with glowing trim drops slightly into an opening dance stance.

onsen-mist.label: 露天温泉雾气
onsen-mist.zh: 竹影环绕的露天木浴池边，一位成年女性肩披浴巾靠在石沿，池面飘起温热白雾。
onsen-mist.en: Beside a bamboo-bordered outdoor wooden bath, an adult woman draped in a bath towel rests against the warm stone edge as steam rises.

jazz-club-dancer.label: 霓虹练功房爵士女舞者
jazz-club-dancer.zh: 低调霓虹侧光照亮的镜面练功室里，一位身着黑色露腰上衣与修身舞裤的成年女舞者扬起下巴准备起舞。
jazz-club-dancer.en: Inside a dimly lit mirrored rehearsal studio edged with neon light, an adult dancer in a sleek black crop top and fitted trousers lifts her chin ready to groove.

moonlit-bath.label: 月色私浴水畔
moonlit-bath.zh: 银白月光洒进安静的半露天汤池，一位成年女性披发靠坐在水边石阶，波光映在肩头。
moonlit-bath.en: Silver moonlight enters a quiet stone bathhouse as an adult woman with loose wet hair rests on the shallow stone step, water reflections dancing across her shoulders.

bedroom-silk.label: 暖灯床畔丝影
bedroom-silk.zh: 暖灯低照的静室床畔，一位成年女性披着系带丝质睡裙半靠在软枕上。
bedroom-silk.en: By a dimly lit bedside under warm lamplight, an adult woman wearing a belted silk slip leans lightly against soft pillows.

midnight-wine-sofa.label: 夜室丝衣微醺沙发
midnight-wine-sofa.zh: 深夜微光的静室皮质沙发上，一位成年女性斜靠着，酒红色细肩带丝裙垂落膝边。
midnight-wine-sofa.en: In a dimly lit lounge at midnight, an adult woman reclines lightly on a soft sofa in a deep burgundy silk slip dress.

raise-umbrella.label: 举伞望向弯道
raise-umbrella.zh: 旅人略抬伞沿，抬眼看向轨道拐弯处。
raise-umbrella.en: The traveler tips the umbrella up and looks toward the bend in the tracks.

look-up-from-letter.label: 读信抬眼
look-up-from-letter.zh: 读到末尾时，读信人的指尖停在信纸边上，视线顺着窗台慢慢抬起。
look-up-from-letter.en: As the reader reaches the end of the letter, their fingertips pause on the edge of the page and their eyes lift toward the window.

swaying-lantern.label: 灯笼轻摆
swaying-lantern.zh: 风从巷口吹进来，灯笼沿一条短弧轻轻摆动。
swaying-lantern.en: A draft from the mouth of the alley sets the lantern swaying in a shallow arc.

reach-for-book.label: 伸手取同一本书
reach-for-book.zh: 两人同时向书脊伸手，指尖快要相碰时一起停下来，抬眼看向对方。
reach-for-book.en: Both reach for the spine and pause just before their fingertips meet, then look up at each other.

blink.label: 自然眨眼
blink.zh: 人物自然呼吸，轻轻眨一次眼，视线保持在原来的方向。
blink.en: The subject breathes gently and blinks once, with their gaze still pointing in the original direction.

glance-back.label: 缓缓回眸
glance-back.zh: 人物先用余光看向画外，再慢慢转过头，嘴角轻轻抬起。
glance-back.en: The subject glances just offscreen, then slowly turns their head and lets a small smile form.

breeze.label: 风动发丝衣缘
breeze.zh: 人物维持首帧姿势，微风先掀起发梢，继而带动衣缘。
breeze.en: The subject keeps the opening pose as a breeze lifts the tips of their hair and then stirs the edge of their clothes.

two-steps.label: 顺势走两步
two-steps.zh: 人物沿原来的朝向自然地迈出两步，第二步轻轻放慢。
two-steps.en: The subject takes two easy steps in the direction they already face and slows on the second.

tuck-hair.label: 耳后撩发
tuck-hair.zh: 她抬起指尖把颊边滑落的一缕头发轻拨到耳后，眼神柔和地望向前面。
tuck-hair.en: She raises her fingers to tuck a loose strand of hair behind her ear while her gaze softens ahead.

gentle-smile.label: 温柔浅笑
gentle-smile.zh: 她微微放缓呼吸，眼波舒展，嘴角流露出自然温和的笑意。
gentle-smile.en: She takes a calm breath as her eyes relax and a gentle smile forms on her lips.

shy-blush.label: 害羞避目轻抿唇
shy-blush.zh: 她的眼神略微闪躲，双颊泛起浅浅红晕，随即轻轻抿了抿唇。
shy-blush.en: Her gaze darts shyly aside as a soft blush warms her cheeks and she presses her lips together gently.

sip-warm-cup.label: 捧杯轻抿暖饮
sip-warm-cup.zh: 她双手托起瓷杯靠近唇边轻抿一口，热气漫过指尖后缓缓放下杯子。
sip-warm-cup.en: She lifts the warm cup in both hands for a slow sip as gentle steam curls past her fingers, then lowers it calmly.

catch-petal.label: 伸手接落瓣
catch-petal.zh: 她停下脚步微微摊开掌心，指尖在空中接住一片飘落的花瓣。
catch-petal.en: She pauses and opens her palm upward, catching a drifting blossom petal gently on her fingertips.

turn-in-wind.label: 风中转身回望
turn-in-wind.zh: 一阵晚风掠过发梢时，她顺势轻转过半边身子，向镜头这边望过来。
turn-in-wind.en: As a passing breeze lifts her hair, she turns smoothly half-way around and looks back toward the camera.

look-up-sky.label: 轻仰头望天际
look-up-sky.zh: 她缓缓抬起下巴望向高处天光，睫毛轻眨，颈侧线条安静舒展。
look-up-sky.en: She slowly tilts her chin upward toward the sky, blinking softly as her neckline catches the light.

adjust-scarf.label: 轻拢围巾衣领
adjust-scarf.zh: 她双手轻轻拢紧颈间的围巾或衣领，下巴微低又顺势抬头看向前方。
adjust-scarf.en: She draws her scarf gently closer around her neck with both hands, tucking her chin briefly before looking ahead.

turn-page.label: 指尖轻翻书页
turn-page.zh: 她用指尖轻轻掀起一页纸张顺平在掌心，目光安静地滑过页面。
turn-page.en: Her fingertips lift and turn a single page smoothly while her eyes travel calmly across the sheet.

lean-window.label: 倚窗托腮凝思
lean-window.zh: 她将手肘轻搭在窗台，掌心托起脸颊，眼神温柔地望向窗外流动的景致。
lean-window.en: Resting one elbow on the windowsill, she props her cheek lightly in her palm and gazes serenely outside.

hair-flip-breeze.label: 长发随转头轻扬
hair-flip-breeze.zh: 她轻巧偏头甩开肩上的长发，发丝在光影里散开后轻柔垂落。
hair-flip-breeze.en: She tilts her head cleanly so her long hair fans off her shoulders in the light before settling softly.

tiptoe-water.label: 赤足轻点浅水波纹
tiptoe-water.zh: 她提起脚尖在水面轻点一下，水花微溅后激起一圈向四周荡开的波纹。
tiptoe-water.en: She dips her bare toes lightly into the shallow water, sending a crisp ring of ripples spreading outward.

lift-hem-step.label: 轻提裙摆缓步转身
lift-hem-step.zh: 她用指尖微提裙角迈出半步，裙摆顺着脚踝轻晃，转身露出一抹清浅笑意。
lift-hem-step.en: Pinching the hem of her skirt slightly, she takes a light half-step and turns with a quiet smile.

reach-lens.label: 轻抬手迎向镜头
reach-lens.zh: 她朝镜头方向轻轻抬起一只手，指尖几乎伸向画面前景，眼神带着邀请。
reach-lens.en: She gently reaches one hand forward toward the lens, fingers open with an inviting glance.

stretch-waking.label: 轻轻伸展肩背
stretch-waking.zh: 她舒展双肩轻轻抬臂，头微向一侧偏落，随后吐气放松下来。
stretch-waking.en: She rolls her shoulders and stretches lightly, tilting her head to one side before relaxing with a slow exhale.

turn-dress-sway.label: 轻盈半转扬起衣摆
turn-dress-sway.zh: 她原地轻快地转过半圈，裙摆与长发随转身的弧度划开一道流畅波纹。
turn-dress-sway.en: She pivots gracefully through a half-turn on the spot, sending her skirt and hair fanning out in a fluid arc.

idol-step-wink.label: 踩点舞步与眨眼招手
idol-step-wink.zh: 保留首帧服装与构图，她顺着明快节拍轻踏小舞步并轻晃双肩，抬手在颊边俏皮招手并单眼轻眨一下，发梢与裙褶随之弹跳摆动。
idol-step-wink.en: Keeping the opening outfit and framing, she steps lightly in place to an upbeat rhythm with lively shoulder bounces, waves playfully near her cheek, and winks while her hair and pleated skirt sway.

finger-heart-sway.label: 节拍左右摇摆比心
finger-heart-sway.zh: 她踩着轻快节奏柔柔左右摆动肩腰与重心，双手抬至胸前指尖轻轻并成小巧比心手势，发丝随律动轻晃。
finger-heart-sway.en: Swaying smoothly side to side in a lively cadence, she lifts both hands to chest height to form a crisp finger heart while her hair bounces lightly.

waltz-spin-skirt.label: 踮脚轻旋舒展舞裙
waltz-spin-skirt.zh: 她踮起脚尖顺畅地原地旋转半圈，双臂沿优雅弧线轻舒，长裙与飘带随惯性向四周荡开柔和波浪。
waltz-spin-skirt.en: Rising onto her toes, she glides through a graceful spin as her arms sweep in a ballet arc and her skirt and ribbons flare smoothly outward.

ribbon-sleeve-dance.label: 广袖拂风轻身舞转
ribbon-sleeve-dance.zh: 她手腕轻扬甩出一侧长袖与衣袂，腰肢柔韧微旋并提步画弧，宽袖与发梢顺着气流在空中缓缓落定。
ribbon-sleeve-dance.en: With a flick of her wrist she sweeps a flowing sleeve across the frame, turning gracefully on light feet so fabric and hair trail softly through the air.

shoulder-groove-hair.label: 节拍律动拂发轻舞
shoulder-groove-hair.zh: 她跟上利落节拍交替轻抖双肩、微侧腰身并偏头拂开肩上长发，眼神明亮地跟着节奏锁定前方。
shoulder-groove-hair.en: Catching a crisp groove, she alternates light shoulder pops, shifts her waist smoothly, and tilts her head to sweep her long hair over one shoulder with a confident gaze.

hand-gesture-beat.label: 指尖手势卡点舞
hand-gesture-beat.zh: 保留首帧取景与衣着，她双手抬至胸前利落切换手势、轻叩腕线并做出俏皮折臂停顿，眼神明亮带笑。
hand-gesture-beat.en: Keeping the opening framing and outfit, she raises both hands to chest height and switches cleanly through crisp finger gestures and wrist turns in tight rhythm with a bright smile.

ballet-pirouette.label: 芭蕾足尖旋转与舒展
ballet-pirouette.zh: 她轻轻立起足尖并拢双臂成环顺畅旋转一圈，随后单臂向前优雅延伸平衡收尾，薄纱裙摆随之荡起涟漪。
ballet-pirouette.en: Rising smoothly onto pointe, she gathers her arms in an oval to spin cleanly through a pirouette before extending into a poised arabesque balance as her tulle skirt floats.

cyber-popping-hit.label: 机械舞震动卡点波浪
cyber-popping-hit.zh: 做出干脆的肩胸震动顿点与关节急停，随即顺着双臂送出一道丝滑机械波浪，眼神冷冽直视前方。
cyber-popping-hit.en: Hitting sharp chest and shoulder isolations with crisp cadence, she snaps cleanly into robotic stops before sending a fluid wave smoothly down both arms with a sharp gaze.

fan-turn-grace.label: 折扇掩面国风轻旋
fan-turn-grace.zh: 她轻翻手腕用折扇或袖缘半遮笑颜，随即沉腰轻快旋身半周并顺势展开衣袖，长发与裙袂顺气流盈盈飘扬。
fan-turn-grace.en: Flicking her wrist to veil half her smile behind a fan or sleeve edge, she pivots gracefully through a light half-turn as silk hems and hair trail smoothly in the breeze.

latin-hip-spin.label: 拉丁炫目拧腰甩裙转
latin-hip-spin.zh: 她踩着急促切分步利落迈步拧腰摆胯，随后快速旋转半圈并干脆甩头望向镜头，裙摆与发梢呈放射状扬开。
latin-hip-spin.en: Stepping sharply into syncopated Latin timing, she twists smoothly at the hips and snaps into a crisp spin with a fiery head turn as her skirt flares wide.

wrist-shuffle-groove.label: 爆款丝滑翻腕摇摆舞
wrist-shuffle-groove.zh: 她保持轻松笑意，双手在胸前灵活内外翻腕画圈，同时双膝与腰胯配合轻快滑步节奏左右丝滑摇摆。
wrist-shuffle-groove.en: With a cheerful grin, she flips both wrists in fluid figure-eight turns before her chest while sliding smoothly side to side in bouncy shuffle steps.

cute-wiggle-bounce.label: 萌趣欢乐原地摇摆舞
cute-wiggle-bounce.zh: 保持首帧萌趣造型，主体欢快地上下轻蹦并左右大幅摇摆腰臀，双手或前爪俏皮配合摆动并歪头单眼轻眨。
cute-wiggle-bounce.en: Keeping the opening cute look, the subject bounces playfully in an energetic rhythm with exaggerated side-to-side hip wiggles, lively arm swings, and a cheeky head-tilt wink.

forehead-touch.label: 慢慢贴上额头
forehead-touch.zh: 两人微倾肩颈缓缓靠近，直到额头轻轻相贴并柔柔合上双眼。
forehead-touch.en: The two adults incline slowly toward each other until their foreheads gently meet, their eyes softly closing at contact.

lean-on-shoulder.label: 缓缓靠上肩头
lean-on-shoulder.zh: 她放慢动作轻轻靠向伴侣肩头，指尖搭上衣袖并微微合上双眸。
lean-on-shoulder.en: She eases closer to rest her head against her partner's shoulder, fingers resting lightly on the sleeve as her eyes close.

near-kiss.label: 缓缓贴近轻合双眼
near-kiss.zh: 两人保持咫尺距离缓缓靠近，呼吸轻缓，眼神交汇后柔柔合上双眸。
near-kiss.en: The two adults lean inward across the narrow gap, breaths slowing as their eyes meet and gently close.

onsen-soak.label: 指尖轻拨温泉水面
onsen-soak.zh: 她把手臂搭在池沿，指尖在水面轻轻划开一圈缓慢扩散的涟漪。
onsen-soak.en: Resting one arm along the stone edge, she trails her fingertips gently through the warm water to send slow ripples outward.

alluring-hip-sway.label: 慢拍轻摆腰胯魅舞
alluring-hip-sway.zh: 成年舞者以舒缓律动轻柔画弧摆动腰胯，一手轻搭颈侧微扬下巴，发丝随动势滑过肩头，目光魅惑追随镜头。
alluring-hip-sway.en: The adult dancer rolls and sways her hips smoothly in a slow cadence, resting one hand lightly near her neck while lifting her chin with an alluring gaze toward the lens.

jazz-body-roll.label: 爵士 S 形身体波浪甩发
jazz-body-roll.zh: 成年舞者从微仰头颈顺肩胸至腰胯流畅做出一道 S 形身体波浪，随即利落甩发并扬眉望向镜头。
jazz-body-roll.en: The adult dancer ripples smoothly from chin and chest down through a fluid S-curve body roll, snapping her hair aside with a bold glance straight toward the lens.

wipe-glass-sway.label: 卡点擦玻璃手势摇摆舞
wipe-glass-sway.zh: 成年舞者抬起双掌在胸前随慢节奏交替划出顺滑画圆擦拭手势，腰胯配合动势柔韧左右轻扭，眼神拉丝望向镜头。
wipe-glass-sway.en: Lifting both palms before her chest, the adult dancer traces smooth alternating circular wiping gestures in a slow rhythm while swaying her hips softly with an alluring gaze.

robe-edge.label: 指尖理顺袍边
robe-edge.zh: 模特慢慢把指尖沿袍边滑过去，捋平一处褶皱。
robe-edge.en: The model slowly runs their fingertips along the robe's edge, smoothing one fold in the silk.

profile-light.label: 侧脸慢慢入光
profile-light.zh: 保留首帧衣着和姿态，面孔缓缓转进侧光，目光落向画外。
profile-light.en: The subject keeps the opening wardrobe and posture as their face turns slowly into the side light and their gaze settles offscreen.

slip-shoulder-strap.label: 指尖轻推滑落肩带
slip-shoulder-strap.zh: 成年女性抬起一侧指尖轻推细肩带，让丝滑布料顺着肩头缓缓滑落半寸。
slip-shoulder-strap.en: The adult subject lifts her fingertips to nudge one delicate strap aside, letting the silk slip smoothly half an inch off her shoulder.

unfasten-ribbon.label: 缓解放开丝带松开衣襟
unfasten-ribbon.zh: 她低垂目光，指尖沿着腰侧丝带缓缓抽开结扣，丝质衣襟随呼吸自然微敞。
unfasten-ribbon.en: Looking down softly, she unties the silk waist ribbon with slow fingers, letting the robe loosen naturally as she breathes.

finger-collarbone.label: 指尖轻拂锁骨与颈侧
finger-collarbone.zh: 她保留首帧衣着与姿态，指尖沿颈侧缓缓滑过锁骨边缘，肩颈随呼吸轻伏。
finger-collarbone.en: Keeping her opening wardrobe and pose, she glides her fingertips slowly down her neck and along her collarbone as her shoulders rise and fall.

drape-shoulder-silk.label: 轻侧身滑落薄纱外披
drape-shoulder-silk.zh: 成年女性随缓呼吸微转肩背，垂在肩头的薄纱外披顺滑滑落至臂弯，露出柔和肩线。
drape-shoulder-silk.en: With an unhurried breath, the adult subject turns her shoulder slightly so the sheer drape slips smoothly down to the crook of her arm.

trace-waist-lace.label: 指尖轻抚腰侧丝带褶皱
trace-waist-lace.zh: 她保持微倚姿态，指尖顺着腰际丝缎与褶皱缓缓抚过，眼神半垂带着慵懒暖意。
trace-waist-lace.en: Remaining poised against the backdrop, she trails her fingertips gently over the gathered silk and ribbon along her waist with a warm, languid gaze.

sensual-slow-dance.label: 暗光慢舞肩腰摇曳
sensual-slow-dance.zh: 保留首帧衣着与身姿，成年舞者以舒缓韵律柔柔扭转肩腰并交替轻移重心，丝质衣摆顺着曲线滑荡摆动。
sensual-slow-dance.en: Keeping her opening outfit and silhouette, the adult dancer rolls her shoulders and shifts her hips slowly in a languid rhythm as the silk fabric glides across her curves.

intimate-chair-sway.label: 近景慵懒慢舞椅畔摇曳
intimate-chair-sway.zh: 保留首帧衣着与倚坐姿态，成年舞者以舒缓韵律柔柔仰起颈线、肩腰顺滑左右慢摆，指尖轻抚过腰侧衣料。
intimate-chair-sway.en: Keeping her opening wardrobe and poised seated silhouette, the adult dancer arches her neck smoothly and sways slowly side to side in a languid cadence as her fingertips glide lightly along her waist.

shift-weight.label: 重心转到尾帧
shift-weight.zh: 先让人物轻移重心，再让身体和视线沿同一方向转向尾帧。
shift-weight.en: The subject shifts their weight first, then lets their body and gaze turn continuously toward the final pose.

depth-transition.label: 前后景逐渐错开
depth-transition.zh: 随着景别变化，主体与前后景逐步错开，画面沿同一方向连续过渡。
depth-transition.en: As the framing changes, the layers of depth gradually separate in one continuous direction.

soft-breath.label: 呼吸贯穿过渡
soft-breath.zh: 人物保持连贯的自然呼吸，细小的姿态变化接向尾帧。
soft-breath.en: The subject breathes softly as the small changes in posture lead into the final frame.

profile-shift.label: 侧影逐渐展开
profile-shift.zh: 视角变化时，近处轮廓先错开，人物的侧影随之逐渐显露。
profile-shift.en: As the viewpoint changes, nearby edges slide apart first and the subject's profile gradually comes into view.

eyes-open-fl.label: 由轻合眼缓缓睁眸迎光
eyes-open-fl.zh: 人物从首帧轻闭的双眸开始，长睫轻颤后缓缓睁眼，目光清晰落向尾帧焦点。
eyes-open-fl.en: Starting with eyes softly closed, her lashes flutter as her eyes open gradually to meet the gaze of the final frame.

dusk-to-lamps-fl.label: 暮色渐深暖灯逐盏亮起
dusk-to-lamps-fl.zh: 随着暮色沉降，周围的暖色灯光渐次亮起，人影与环境光线平稳衔接至尾帧。
dusk-to-lamps-fl.en: As twilight deepens smoothly, warm interior lamps brighten gradually to unite figure and lighting with the final frame.

back-to-turn-fl.label: 从背影缓缓回身定格目光
back-to-turn-fl.zh: 人物从首帧背对镜头的站姿缓缓转肩回望，衣摆微动后定格在尾帧的眼神里。
back-to-turn-fl.en: From the opening back-view stance, the subject turns smoothly over one shoulder to settle into the expression of the last frame.

skirt-settle-fl.label: 发丝衣摆随动势渐稳落定
skirt-settle-fl.zh: 首帧扬起的裙角与长发顺着气流弧度渐弱垂落，自然收拢进尾帧的静谧姿态。
skirt-settle-fl.en: Lifted hair and skirt hems settle smoothly out of their opening arc into the calm resting silhouette of the final frame.

shared-lean.label: 两人逐渐靠拢
shared-lean.zh: 两人先看向对方，再缓缓靠拢，让肩颈和额头沿尾帧方向自然收住。
shared-lean.en: The two adults look toward each other and gradually lean closer, letting their shoulders and foreheads settle along the path established by the last frame.

smile-bloom.label: 神情渐展笑意落到尾帧
smile-bloom.zh: 她的眉眼从首帧的平静里慢慢舒展，唇角逐渐扬起并自然衔接到尾帧神情。
smile-bloom.en: Her expression softens gradually from the opening calm, breaking into the warm smile of the final frame.

turn-to-camera.label: 从侧影缓转面向镜头
turn-to-camera.zh: 她从首帧的侧身姿态缓缓转向正面，肩颈与目光顺滑地停在尾帧朝向。
turn-to-camera.en: She turns smoothly from her opening side stance toward the lens, aligning her shoulders and gaze with the final frame.

step-closer.label: 缓步走近收窄景深
step-closer.zh: 人物从较远站位迈出平稳两步靠近镜头，前景微晃后停在尾帧的取景距离。
step-closer.en: Taking two unhurried steps forward from the wider opening stance, the subject closes the distance to meet the final framing.

dance-pose-bridge.label: 舞姿顺拍旋转衔接尾帧
dance-pose-bridge.zh: 角色从首帧舞姿起势，顺着圆弧轻转腰身并抬臂划过空间，发梢与裙摆随惯性自然落在尾帧收拍造型上。
dance-pose-bridge.en: From the opening dance stance, the dancer turns smoothly at the waist and sweeps her arms through one fluid arc so hair and skirt settle cleanly into the final pose.

robe-loosen-transition.label: 衣襟与光影随呼吸渐展对齐尾帧
robe-loosen-transition.zh: 成年主体在平稳呼吸间让肩侧丝料与身姿缓缓过渡，与尾帧的松弛轮廓及光线对齐。
robe-loosen-transition.en: Between steady breaths, the adult subject eases her posture and draped silk smoothly into the relaxed silhouette and lighting of the final frame.

focused.label: 专注平静
focused.zh: 目光专注，神态放松，表情变化轻微。
focused.en: The gaze is attentive and the expression remains relaxed, with small changes around the eyes.

bright.label: 轻快明朗
bright.zh: 眼神清亮，神态轻快，眉眼随情绪自然变化。
bright.en: The subject has a bright, open expression, with natural changes around the eyes and brows.

soft-eye-contact.label: 放松的眼神
soft-eye-contact.zh: 眼神放松，眉眼只在情绪变动时稍有起伏。
soft-eye-contact.en: The gaze is soft and the brows change only slightly with the emotion.

gentle-warm.label: 温柔含笑
gentle-warm.zh: 神态温柔舒展，眼底带着轻微笑意，微表情自然流畅。
gentle-warm.en: The expression is gentle and warm, with a soft smile in the eyes and natural micro-expressions.

thoughtful-calm.label: 安静思索
thoughtful-calm.zh: 神色恬静沉思，目光柔和微凝，随呼吸呈现克制的微表情。
thoughtful-calm.en: The expression stays quiet and contemplative, with steady, restrained micro-expressions.

whispering-lips.label: 轻语浅笑
whispering-lips.zh: 唇边噙着轻巧笑意，随动作或音节流露细腻的轻声交谈感。
whispering-lips.en: A delicate smile lingers at the lips, lending an intimate, softly spoken cadence to the expression.

shy-glance.label: 含蓄微羞
shy-glance.zh: 眼神含蓄微垂，神情带着细腻的羞怯起伏。
shy-glance.en: The gaze carries a subtle shyness, with delicate shifts around the eyes and cheeks.

playful-lively.label: 明快灵动
playful-lively.zh: 眉梢轻挑，神态灵动富有朝气，节奏明快自然。
playful-lively.en: The brows lift lightly with lively, cheerful expression changes in rhythm with the driver.

stage-idol-expression.label: 舞台踩点灵动表情
stage-idol-expression.zh: 眼神明亮有神、唇角伴随节奏轻扬微笑，在肢体律动中保持鲜活自然的舞台感染力。
stage-idol-expression.en: Bright, lively eyes and a rhythmic performance smile carry radiant stage presence throughout the driven dance motion.

tender-gaze.label: 深情凝望
tender-gaze.zh: 成年角色目光专注而温柔地停留在眼前，神色绵长贴近。
tender-gaze.en: The adult subject holds a tender, lingering gaze ahead with quiet emotional closeness.

motion-jazz-charm.label: 爵士舞台魅力眼神
motion-jazz-charm.zh: 成年舞者眉眼锐利带笑，嘴角噙着自信魅惑神态，头肩卡点与镜头追随动作自然连贯。
motion-jazz-charm.en: The adult dancer holds a confident, sultry stage smile with crisp eye-lock and natural rhythmic poise throughout the driven dance motion.

intimate-haze.label: 微醺松弛
intimate-haze.zh: 眼神微倦而深情，唇角与呼吸起伏柔和松弛。
intimate-haze.en: The gaze is languid and affectionate, with soft, unhurried changes in expression.

still.label: 固定
still.en: The camera holds a locked-off frame.

push.label: 推进
push.zh: 镜头小幅缓慢推近主体。
push.en: The camera pushes in slowly over a short distance.

zoom-slow-in.label: 缓推聚焦
zoom-slow-in.zh: 镜头极缓推进聚焦神态，前景柔和虚化退开。
zoom-slow-in.en: The camera slowly dollies in to focus gently on the subject's expression while the foreground softens.

pull.label: 拉远
pull.zh: 镜头小幅缓慢拉远，渐渐露出主体周围的空间。
pull.en: The camera pulls back slowly over a short distance to reveal more of the setting.

pan.label: 横移
pan.zh: 镜头以平缓速度小幅横移。
pan.en: The camera tracks sideways at an even pace over a short distance.

orbit.label: 环绕
orbit.zh: 镜头沿主体周围的一小段弧线缓慢移动。
orbit.en: The camera arcs slowly around the subject through a shallow angle.

tilt-up.label: 缓摇仰起
tilt-up.zh: 机位稳住，镜头顺着主体身姿缓缓向上微仰。
tilt-up.en: From a steady position, the camera tilts upward slowly along the subject.

tilt-down.label: 缓摇俯落
tilt-down.zh: 镜头从上方光影处缓缓向下俯摇，视线落回主体。
tilt-down.en: The camera tilts downward gently to settle focus back onto the subject.

follow.label: 平稳跟拍
follow.zh: 镜头以均速平稳跟随主体移动，保持她在画面的位置稳定。
follow.en: The camera glides alongside the moving subject at a smooth, steady pace.

low-glide.label: 低角度缓移
low-glide.zh: 镜头略低于视线平稳小幅横移仰拍，衬托起舞身姿同时保持动作重心清晰。
low-glide.en: From a slightly low angle, the camera glides smoothly sideways to frame the dancer cleanly without losing balance.

handheld.label: 微呼吸手持
handheld.zh: 镜头带有一丝柔和的手持呼吸微晃，贴近临场氛围。
handheld.en: The camera carries a subtle handheld breathing motion for an immediate, lived-in feel.

tram-lights.label: 车灯映亮积水
tram-lights.zh: 远处车灯逐渐亮起，暖色倒影顺着站台边的积水拉长。
tram-lights.en: Distant headlights brighten and stretch warm reflections across puddles along the platform edge.

sheer-curtain.label: 晨光透过纱帘
sheer-curtain.zh: 轻风托起白纱帘，原本透过帘子的亮斑随之滑过近处表面。
sheer-curtain.en: A breeze lifts the sheer curtain and slides a patch of morning light across the nearest surface.

lantern-shadows.label: 墙上暖影轻晃
lantern-shadows.zh: 暖色光斑随摆动在墙面上缓慢往复。
lantern-shadows.en: A patch of amber light travels slowly back and forth across the wall.

neon-rain.label: 细雨映霓虹
neon-rain.zh: 细雨沿窗面滑下，霓虹倒影在水痕间轻轻游移。
neon-rain.en: Fine rain trails down the glass and carries the neon reflections with it.

depth-parallax.label: 近景掠过
depth-parallax.zh: 近处景物缓缓掠过视野，远景移动得更慢。
depth-parallax.en: Nearby objects drift past faster than the distant background.

rising-light.label: 光线逐渐铺开
rising-light.zh: 亮处从光源附近慢慢扩开，墙面与衣料上的阴影同步变淡，接近尾帧的色温。
rising-light.en: Light spreads from its source and softens the shadows on fabric and walls as the color approaches the last frame.

warm-window.label: 暖窗光
warm-window.zh: 柔暖侧光掠过脸颊，阴影边缘平缓，背景维持原有空间关系。
warm-window.en: Warm side light grazes the cheek, with soft-edged shadows and a stable background.

cool-fill.label: 冷色柔光
cool-fill.zh: 冷色柔光均匀照亮面部，原图的明暗层次在动作中保持稳定。
cool-fill.en: Cool soft light keeps the face legible, preserving the source image's light and shade throughout the motion.

dusk-softness.label: 暮色窗光
dusk-softness.zh: 余晖从窗外漫进来，靠窗的一侧脸颊染上柔和暖色。
dusk-softness.en: Last light from the window casts a soft, warm hue on the cheeks closest to it.

linen-light.label: 纱帘散射的侧光
linen-light.zh: 侧光穿过纱帘，把亮部的边缘拉柔，背景留在安静的暗部。
linen-light.en: Light diffuses through the curtain, softening the edges of the highlights against a quiet background.

sakura-drift.label: 樱瓣随风轻飘
sakura-drift.zh: 几片淡粉樱花花瓣随微风缓缓斜掠过画面前景与背景。
sakura-drift.en: Pale pink cherry blossom petals drift diagonally across the foreground and background in a gentle breeze.

ginkgo-leaves.label: 秋叶金黄飘落
ginkgo-leaves.zh: 金黄银杏落叶在午后斜阳里打着旋缓缓飘落，路面与发梢镀上暖金光色。
ginkgo-leaves.en: Golden ginkgo leaves spiral lazily down through slanted afternoon sunlight, warming the path and hair edges.

golden-sunset.label: 夕阳金辉流转
golden-sunset.zh: 温暖的金色夕阳洒在发梢与轮廓边缘，空气中浮起点点暖光颗粒。
golden-sunset.en: Warm golden sunset light rims the hair and shoulders, filling the air with a soft amber glow.

snow-fall.label: 细雪缓缓飘落
snow-fall.zh: 细碎的雪花在夜色与微光中缓缓飘落，前景虚化出柔和光斑。
snow-fall.en: Fine snowflakes drift slowly through the cool light, with soft out-of-focus flakes passing near the lens.

moonlit-mist.label: 月色薄雾流动
moonlit-mist.zh: 清冷的银白月光穿透微薄夜雾，在暗部边缘勾出一圈静谧轮廓。
moonlit-mist.en: Cool silver moonlight filters through drifting night mist, tracing a quiet rim light along the shadows.

firefly-night.label: 夏夜萤火微光
firefly-night.zh: 几点清亮的暖黄萤火虫在夜色草木间缓缓浮起闪烁，虚化出柔和光晕。
firefly-night.en: Soft points of warm firefly light float and pulse lazily through the dark summer foliage.

fireworks-glow.label: 远空烟火微光映照
fireworks-glow.zh: 远方夜空的绚烂烟火散开一瞬彩光，在她的发梢与眼底映出轻柔流光。
fireworks-glow.en: Distant night fireworks bloom briefly in the sky, casting gentle shifting colors across her hair and eyes.

blinds-stripes.label: 百叶窗斜影光条
blinds-stripes.zh: 倾斜的午后日光透过百叶窗落成温柔的明暗光条，随呼吸在肩背与墙面轻移。
blinds-stripes.en: Slanted afternoon sun falls through window blinds in soft ribbons of light and shadow across her shoulders and wall.

warm-steam.label: 温泉暖雾升腾
warm-steam.zh: 温润的白雾从水面袅袅升起，暖灯在湿润皮肤与空气里晕开柔光。
warm-steam.en: Warm white steam rises gently from the water, softening the ambient light across damp skin and air.

pool-caustics.label: 水波折射波光流淌
pool-caustics.zh: 清澈池水折射出的细碎银蓝波光，在肩颈与墙面间缓缓流转晃动。
pool-caustics.en: Rippling water caustics cast soft shifting ribbons of cool light across the shoulders and stone walls.

dappled-shade.label: 林荫光斑摇曳
dappled-shade.zh: 树叶间隙投下的斑驳阳光在衣料与桌面轻轻摇曳。
dappled-shade.en: Dappled sunlight filtering through leaves shifts softly across clothing and nearby surfaces.

sea-breeze.label: 海风与碎金波光
sea-breeze.zh: 平稳的海风吹起碎发，身后的浪面闪动着成片柔和的碎金反光。
sea-breeze.en: A steady sea breeze stirs loose strands of hair as scattered golden reflections shimmer across the waves behind.

candle-bokeh.label: 暖烛光斑微颤
candle-bokeh.zh: 前景与背景的暖色光斑轻微晃动，映在眼底显得温存而安静。
candle-bokeh.en: Warm candlelit bokeh flickers gently in the background, catching soft points of light in her eyes.

stage-spotlight.label: 舞台追光与星尘
stage-spotlight.zh: 柔亮的顶部舞台追光勾勒出肩线与发梢轮廓，空气中飘浮微光星尘，深色背景退隐突出舞姿。
stage-spotlight.en: A crisp overhead stage spotlight rims her shoulders and hair while fine glowing dust motes drift against a softly darkened backdrop.

neon-beat-glow.label: 霓虹节拍流光
neon-beat-glow.zh: 紫粉与冷蓝霓虹轮廓光在暗调空间柔和流转，随摆动在衣料折痕与地面反光间闪烁。
neon-beat-glow.en: Magenta and cool cyan neon rim lights pulse gently around the frame, gliding across moving folds of fabric and floor reflections.

sunlit-dance-studio.label: 练功房晨光落地窗
sunlit-dance-studio.zh: 宽敞实木地板练功房内清晨阳光穿过高窗斜落，光柱中轻盈尘粒悬浮，镜面与地板映出柔和亮光。
sunlit-dance-studio.en: Warm morning sunlight streams diagonally across a polished hardwood dance studio, illuminating drifting dust motes and soft floor reflections.

velvet-club-glow.label: 夜场绯红暖金侧光
velvet-club-glow.zh: 微暗夜场里一束绯红混暖金的侧光柔和扫过身姿曲线，背景灯斑随律动微微虚晃。
velvet-club-glow.en: In a dimly lit lounge, warm crimson and amber side light sweeps softly along her silhouette while distant bokeh glows gently behind.

dim-amber-glow.label: 暗室琥珀暖光勾勒轮廓
dim-amber-glow.zh: 昏暗静室里只留一束低角度琥珀暖光，沿肩线、腰侧与丝绸褶皱流淌出柔和明暗。
dim-amber-glow.en: A single low-angle amber glow in the quiet dim room traces warm highlights and soft shadows along the shoulders and silk folds.

settle-gaze.label: 视线落定
settle-gaze.zh: 视线落定后，人物安静地停留片刻。
settle-gaze.en: The subject's gaze settles and holds for a beat.

rest.label: 动势渐歇
rest.zh: 动势逐渐减弱，画面在余动中平稳收住。
rest.en: The movement eases gradually into a calm final beat.

offer-book.label: 让出书本
offer-book.zh: 其中一人轻轻收回手，留下空间让对方取书。
offer-book.en: One reader withdraws their hand, leaving room for the other to take the book.

match-first.label: 回到首帧神情
match-first.zh: 动作结束时，人物回到首帧的神情与姿态。
match-first.en: The subject returns to the opening expression and pose as the movement finishes.

match-last.label: 对齐尾帧
match-last.zh: 临近尾帧时逐渐减速，让姿势、视线、光线与构图自然落到尾帧。
match-last.en: The motion eases into the final frame, matching its pose, gaze, light, and composition.

hold-contact.label: 保持贴额片刻
hold-contact.zh: 贴额后保持原来的距离，只留两次缓慢的自然呼吸。
hold-contact.en: They stay forehead to forehead through two slow, easy breaths.

smile-hold.label: 笑意轻柔定格
smile-hold.zh: 笑意停在眼角与唇边，保持柔和神态与自然呼吸直到画末。
smile-hold.en: The gentle smile lingers in her eyes and lips, holding steady with subtle breathing until the end.

slow-fade.label: 慢镜余韵渐收
slow-fade.zh: 所有动作缓下来留出安静余韵，光影与空间维持平稳。
slow-fade.en: Movement tapers softly into a lingering quiet moment while light and framing stay steady.

look-into-lens.label: 凝视镜头收住
look-into-lens.zh: 视线稳稳落在镜头方向，在微风与呼吸的余动中收尾。
look-into-lens.en: Her gaze holds directly toward the camera as the final gentle motion settles.

turn-away-calm.label: 转回视线留白
turn-away-calm.zh: 她轻轻收回目光望回远处景致，画面留下平和安静的留白。
turn-away-calm.en: She turns her gaze gently back toward the distance, leaving a calm, open final beat.

eyes-flutter-rest.label: 轻眨定格于光影
eyes-flutter-rest.zh: 长睫柔和一眨后静静停在眼前的光色里，余韵悠长。
eyes-flutter-rest.en: Her lashes flutter once before settling calmly in the surrounding light.

dance-pose-hold.label: 收拍摆出结束舞姿
dance-pose-hold.zh: 舞步与臂弧顺着最后半拍收稳，单手摆出俏皮优雅的收尾造型并带笑停留。
dance-pose-hold.en: The rhythm settles cleanly on the final half-beat into a poised finishing dance pose held with a warm smile.

dance-camera-smile.label: 乘势微笑看镜头收拍
dance-camera-smile.zh: 乘着律动余韵保持舒展神采，自信微笑或魅惑眼神顺势直望镜头收尾。
dance-camera-smile.en: Riding the groove into the final beat, she holds an expressive, engaging gaze straight toward the camera.

loop-ready-sway.label: 流畅衔接首帧循环
loop-ready-sway.zh: 收尾动作沿最后半拍顺滑回到首帧重心与朝向，便于衔接成自然循环段落。
loop-ready-sway.en: On the final beat, her weight and posture glide smoothly back toward the opening stance for a clean loop.

close-warm-embrace.label: 呼吸交叠定格暖光
close-warm-embrace.zh: 两人靠在暖光里不再移动，只余细微平稳的呼吸声停留在最后几帧。
close-warm-embrace.en: They linger close together in the warm light, only quiet breathing continuing into the last frames.

soft-breath-close.label: 轻合眼收息停留
soft-breath-close.zh: 呼吸缓缓沉静，轻轻合眼停在近处温柔的光影里。
soft-breath-close.en: Her breathing calms and her eyes rest lightly closed in the soft close light.

room.label: 安静室内
room.zh: 室内只有很轻的环境底声。
room.en: Quiet room tone stays low and even.

rain-glass.label: 雨点敲窗
rain-glass.en: Light rain taps softly against the glass.

wet-platform.label: 站台微雨
wet-platform.zh: 雨滴落到湿站台上，远处带着微弱的车轮声。
wet-platform.en: Rain ticks against the wet platform over a low rumble from the distant tram.

paper.label: 纸张轻响
paper.zh: 安静的室内响起一声轻微的纸张摩擦。
paper.en: A faint rustle comes from the paper in the quiet room.

alley-wind.label: 巷口风声
alley-wind.zh: 轻风穿过巷口，带来短促的檐下摩擦声。
alley-wind.en: A faint draft brushes through the alley and briefly rustles beneath the eaves.

footsteps.label: 脚步轻响
footsteps.zh: 每次脚掌落地都带出细小的脚步声。
footsteps.en: Soft footsteps land in time with the visible steps.

autumn-leaves.label: 踩叶与秋风
autumn-leaves.zh: 晚风掠过树梢，落叶摩擦路面发出干爽轻脆的沙沙声。
autumn-leaves.en: Dry autumn leaves rustle crisply beneath light steps and a cool evening breeze.

train-hum.label: 列车铁轨低鸣
train-hum.zh: 电车沿铁轨平稳行驶，车厢内响起柔和而富有节奏的低鸣与轻微震动。
train-hum.en: The train rolls along the tracks with a steady rhythmic hum and soft window rattle.

cicada-chime.label: 夏蝉与风铃
cicada-chime.zh: 远处传来稀疏的夏日蝉鸣，檐下玻璃风铃随微风发出一声清脆叮响。
cicada-chime.en: Soft summer cicadas drone in the distance as a glass wind chime rings lightly in the breeze.

library-hush.label: 图书馆静谧翻页
library-hush.zh: 木质高架间格外幽静，仅传出轻微的书页翻动声与远处细小脚步。
library-hush.en: Hushed library ambience carries the soft turn of a page and a faint distant footstep.

fireplace-crackle.label: 壁炉木柴轻响
fireplace-crackle.zh: 静室壁炉里传来极轻的木柴噼啪声与温柔暖风底噪。
fireplace-crackle.en: A distant hearth crackles softly over a quiet, warm indoor room tone.

breath-and-knit.label: 轻呼吸与衣料声
breath-and-knit.zh: 室内底声很轻，靠近时针织衣料擦过一次，之后只听见自然的呼吸。
breath-and-knit.en: Quiet room tone continues, with a soft brush of knit fabric as they lean in and normal breathing as they settle.

silk-rustle.label: 丝料轻响
silk-rustle.zh: 手指理过袍边时传来细微的丝料摩擦声。
silk-rustle.en: A quiet rustle of silk follows the motion of the hand against the robe.

sea-waves.label: 海浪海风
sea-waves.zh: 温柔的潮汐拍打湿沙，夹着平稳的海风声。
sea-waves.en: Gentle waves wash softly over wet sand beneath a steady coastal breeze.

sakura-breeze.label: 微风拂叶
sakura-breeze.zh: 轻风穿过枝叶沙沙作响，衣料随之发出轻微拂动声。
sakura-breeze.en: A light breeze rustles softly through overhead leaves, accompanied by faint fabric movement.

cafe-murmur.label: 咖啡馆柔噪
cafe-murmur.zh: 远端传出极轻的杯碟轻碰声，与安宁的咖啡馆底噪混在一起。
cafe-murmur.en: Soft cafe ambience murmurs quietly in the background with a faint distant clink of porcelain.

onsen-water.label: 温泉水波
onsen-water.zh: 温热的水波轻拍木沿，热气带来细微的湿润底声。
onsen-water.en: Warm water laps softly against the bath edge beneath the hush of rising steam.

city-night.label: 夜街低鸣
city-night.zh: 潮湿路面传来远处微弱车流声，近处偶有雨滴落下。
city-night.en: Distant city traffic hums softly over damp pavement with sparse droplets falling nearby.

snow-quiet.label: 雪夜静谧
snow-quiet.zh: 落雪吸走了周围杂音，只留极轻的冷风与温和的呼吸声。
snow-quiet.en: Falling snow muffles the night air, leaving only a faint winter draft and soft breathing.

warm-heartbeat.label: 静室微息
warm-heartbeat.zh: 静谧夜室内只有贴近肌肤的轻柔呼吸声与细微衣料摩擦。
warm-heartbeat.en: In the hush of the dim room, only slow intimate breathing and the faint brush of silk are audible.

dance-floor-steps.label: 舞台踩点舞步
dance-floor-steps.zh: 节拍清晰轻巧的鞋尖踏地声与衣摆划过空气的沙沙声交替响起。
dance-floor-steps.en: Crisp rhythmic dance steps tap lightly on the floor beside the airy swish of a turning skirt.

sleeve-and-chime.label: 广袖拂风与环佩声
sleeve-and-chime.zh: 宽袖甩开时带出干爽微风声，伴着细碎清亮的衣饰轻响。
sleeve-and-chime.en: Flowing silk sleeves sweep cleanly through the air with the delicate chime of light ornaments.

finger-snap-clap.label: 响指与拍手卡点
finger-snap-clap.zh: 清脆的指尖响指与轻快掌拍随节拍敲响，衬出干净利落的卡点节奏。
finger-snap-clap.en: Crisp finger snaps and light rhythmic claps accent every clear dance beat.

studio-pointe-floor.label: 练功房木板足尖声
studio-pointe-floor.zh: 宽敞木地板上响起轻柔清晰的舞鞋摩擦与落地足尖声，混着纱裙拂动。
studio-pointe-floor.en: Soft ballet slippers brush and tap cleanly across the polished hardwood studio floor beside fluttering tulle.

piano.label: 稀疏钢琴
piano.zh: 缓慢的单音钢琴留出停顿，末尾轻轻淡去。
piano.en: Sparse piano notes sound at a slow tempo and fade gently near the end.

strings.label: 轻柔弦乐
strings.zh: 低声部弦乐缓慢延续，音量在收尾处渐低。
strings.en: Soft sustained low strings taper toward the end.

guitar.label: 温暖木吉他
guitar.zh: 舒缓的原声木吉他分解和弦在背景轻弹。
guitar.en: Warm fingerpicked acoustic guitar chords play gently at an unhurried tempo.

piano-guitar.label: 吉他与钢琴合奏
piano-guitar.zh: 清澈的木吉他分解伴随轻柔钢琴旋律，节奏舒缓治愈。
piano-guitar.en: Warm acoustic guitar arpeggios blend softly with gentle piano notes in a calm, comforting cadence.

music-box.label: 清澈八音盒
music-box.zh: 晶莹轻缓的八音盒音符响起几拍后轻柔收尾。
music-box.en: Delicate celesta and music-box notes chime gently at a slow pace before fading out.

harp-dream.label: 空灵竖琴
harp-dream.zh: 柔润空灵的竖琴泛音缓缓拨动，随后留白淡出。
harp-dream.en: Airy, shimmering harp plucks drift gently through the space before fading into silence.

ambient-pad.label: 轻柔氛围音垫
ambient-pad.zh: 温润平缓的合成器氛围铺底，带来安静的呼吸感。
ambient-pad.en: Warm, airy ambient synth pads swell subtly underneath without sharp percussion.

jazz-night.label: 深夜爵士低音
jazz-night.zh: 慵懒低沉的爵士电钢与温和低音提琴轻轻流淌。
jazz-night.en: Mellow late-night jazz piano and soft upright bass pulse gently at a slow tempo.

bright-anime.label: 轻快明朗旋律
bright-anime.zh: 清亮活泼的木琴与轻击鼓点奏出明快日系日常旋律。
bright-anime.en: Light marimba, acoustic pluck, and soft brush percussion carry a cheerful slice-of-life melody.

idol-pop-beat.label: 元气偶像踩点节拍
idol-pop-beat.zh: 明亮弹跳的合成器主音配合清脆四拍鼓点，奏出富有感染力的偶像舞曲节奏。
idol-pop-beat.en: Upbeat bright synth plucks and crisp four-on-the-floor pop drums lock into an energetic idol dance beat.

waltz-strings.label: 三拍华尔兹弦乐
waltz-strings.zh: 舒展优雅的三拍子钢琴与弦乐齐奏，伴随轻盈旋转的圆舞曲呼吸感。
waltz-strings.en: Graceful three-quarter waltz piano and sweeping strings swell smoothly with a spinning dance cadence.

synth-dance-groove.label: 霓虹电子舞曲律动
synth-dance-groove.zh: 弹性合成贝斯搭配利落踩镲，构成时尚微醺的夜场节奏鼓点。
synth-dance-groove.en: Warm analog synth bass and crisp hi-hats drive a sleek, hypnotic midnight dance groove.

hiphop-bass-hit.label: 重低音街舞顿点鼓点
hiphop-bass-hit.zh: 饱满厚实的低音鼓点配合干脆军鼓敲击，衬托利落顿点与卡拍波浪。
hiphop-bass-hit.en: Heavy sub-bass drops and crisp electronic snare hits lock tightly onto sharp dance isolations.

latin-guitar-percussion.label: 热情拉丁吉他鼓点
latin-guitar-percussion.zh: 疾走清脆的西班牙木吉他扫弦配合切分手鼓，洋溢炽热节奏感。
latin-guitar-percussion.en: Rapid Spanish acoustic guitar strums and syncopated hand percussion drive a fiery Latin rhythm.

viral-phonk-groove.label: 洗脑短视频卡点电音
viral-phonk-groove.zh: 弹性抓耳的电子贝斯线搭配明快拍手鼓点，节奏紧凑上头。
viral-phonk-groove.en: An addictive upbeat electronic bassline and snappy clap groove power a tight, punchy beat.

image.summary: 霓虹流光里做出肩胸震动顿点与机械臂波浪，低角度缓移。

image.summary: 翻腕掩面旋身并展开袖摆长裙，樱瓣微风中柔和环绕。
